summary: This Divided State is a documentary by first-time filmmaker Steven Greenstreet. It covers the conflict at Utah Valley State College (now Utah Valley University) that arose when Michael Moore was scheduled to speak on campus shortly before the 2004 presidential election.
one_line: Documentary by Steven Greenstreet about the 2004 controversy over Michael Moore's planned speech at Utah Valley State College.
key_facts: This Divided State is a documentary film by first-time filmmaker Steven Greenstreet.
The film details a conflict at Utah Valley State College, now called Utah Valley University.
The conflict arose when controversial figure Michael Moore was scheduled to speak on campus.
Michael Moore's scheduled campus appearance took place shortly before the 2004 presidential election.
Utah Valley State College is now called Utah Valley University.
